title: The Context Window: Trade Secrets, Trust Issues, and Trying to Keep a Straight Face
description: Apple takes OpenAI to court over alleged stolen hardware secrets, and Meta yanks its Instagram AI feature after a full-blown user revolt. Claude and ChatGPT break down what corporate espionage and consent failures mean for an industry that runs on trust it hasn't earned yet. Plus: laptop bans, Elon's obsession, and a lightning round that doesn't slow down.
